summary: Tested LanguageOnboardModal feature. All 5 test cases passed: modal appears after first login, chip selection works, speaker button present, modal dismisses on Continue, modal does NOT appear on second login.
critical_code_review_comments: MINOR: LanguageOnboardModal subtitle text check using partial string 'अपनी भाषा चुनें · ভাষা বেছে নিন · மொழி தேர்வு' — this is fine as it renders correctly in the UI.
TTS auto-play cannot be verified in web preview (audio not supported) — this is expected per mocked_api note.
context_for_next_testing_agent: LanguageOnboardModal fully working. AsyncStorage key lang_onboarded_v1_{userId} correctly prevents re-show on second login. App language updates to Hindi (हिन्दी) after selection and modal dismiss — home screen shows in Hindi correctly.

test_results.TEST_1_modal_appears_after_first_login: PASS - Modal shows with title 'Choose your language', multilingual subtitle, 10 language chips (2-column grid), 'More languages' link, 'Continue in English' button
test_results.TEST_2_language_chip_selection: PASS - Tapped Hindi/हिन्दी chip, it highlighted with primary color border/background, Continue button changed to 'Continue in हिन्दी'
test_results.TEST_3_speaker_button: PASS - Speaker/volume-high icon button found in modal header (aria-label='Replay language prompt'), 44px touch target confirmed in code
test_results.TEST_4_modal_dismisses_on_continue: PASS - Modal dismissed after Continue, app navigated to /home with language updated to Hindi
test_results.TEST_5_modal_no_second_login: PASS - After accepting language, navigated back to login and re-logged in — modal did NOT appear again (AsyncStorage key persisted)
